stories.title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
stories.summary: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats, with the two AI models disagreeing in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races.
stories.zh_title: 在被迫選擇的情況下，Grok 的人工智慧模型選擇了共和黨人。 OpenAI 選擇了民主黨人。
stories.zh_summary: 一項新研究發現，Grok 的 AI 壓倒性地推薦共和黨候選人，而 OpenAI 的 GPT 有利於民主黨，這兩種 AI 模型在近 500 場選舉中 90% 以上的結果存在分歧。

stories.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
stories.summary: On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads. stories.zh_summary: 週四，賓州州長喬許夏皮羅 (Josh Shapiro) 將《人工智慧欺騙性廣告法案》簽署為法律，要求披露人工智慧產生的廣告。該法律要求任何廣告——無論是靜態圖像、視訊、音訊還是文字——「已被 artifi 顯著修改或產生」。

But one dead giveaway of AI is when things look too polished and seamless. To counter that, Blue […]
